title: Epilogue Author
description: Schema for a public author record.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for the author.

name.description: Public display name of the author.

image.description: Image and attribution metadata for the author.

url.description: URL of the image used for the author.

source_url.description: URL identifying the original image source.

license.description: License under which the image may be used.

about.description: Attributed biographical information about the author.

license.description: License under which the biographical text may be used.

source_url.description: URL identifying the source of the biographical text.

origin.description: Information about how the biographical text was produced.

type.description: Origin of the biographical text: human-written, AI-generated, or AI-assisted.

social_links.description: Public social or reference links associated with the author.

x.description: URL of the author's X profile.

instagram.description: URL of the author's Instagram profile.

youtube.description: URL of the author's YouTube channel.

wikipedia.description: URL of the author's Wikipedia entry.
